recipes.name: Lime and Tequila-Infused Strawberries
ingredients_raw: 2 pounds fresh strawberries, hulled and sliced

steps.text: Mix together triple sec, sugar, lime juice, tequila, and lime zest in a medium bowl; stir to dissolve sugar. Pour over strawberries in a large bowl. Let stand, stirring occasionally, until juice forms, about 1 hour.

raw_recipe.headline: Lime and Tequila-Infused Strawberries
raw_recipe.description: These lime and tequila-infused strawberries can be eaten plain or turned into some adult strawberry shortcakes by serving with cake and whipped cream.
raw_recipe.name: Lime and Tequila-Infused Strawberries

review.reviewBody: I absolutely loved this recipe! The strawberries turned out perfectly and the flavor was fantastic. The tequila is not overwhelming and the lime complements the strawberries and the sweetness perfectly. I topped these with fresh whipped cream. I will be making these over and over again!

Made this as dessert for a girl gathering featuring Mexiican food. What a hit this was - recipe requests etc. I doubled the quantities and followed the 'dressing' directions exactly, but used a mix of fresh pineapple, strawberries and blueberries. Served with assortment of Mexican bakery cookies. Really pretty and the taste was fantastic - 8 people, no leftovers. Will definitely make it again - brightened up a winter's day.

Made these as a late night boozy snack for me and my girlfriend. I halved the recipe since I only had 1 lb of strawberries, and these were DELICIOUS!! Ate them straight out of the bowl. We will be making these often. Make sure to stir frequently so you get that delicious juice!
I made this for a party and it was a hit! I think I will add a little more tequila for my friends, next time.

SO. GOOD. Took everyone's advice and set a timer to stir it every 10 minutes while I made shortcakes and it turned out amazing! Topped the "Scrumptious Strawberry Shortcake" recipes from AR with these babies, added a dollop of whipped cream, and nommed on it with a gigantic smile on my face. mmm...can't wait to pop a few of these into my limeade, too! So many ways to enjoy this recipe!

I took these strawberries to an allrecipes get together and served them with Easter Lemon Bread from this site and they were a huge hit! I doubled the recipe but otherwise made no other changes. This is going in the keeper file! Thanks for sharing your recipe, brandilynn7!

I made this for a party with friends and everyone went crazy for it! It's strawberry season and I had a flat from the farmer's market, so I actually doubled this recipe. I served it with pound cake and fresh whipped cream, but honestly I could just eat a bowl of these strawberries. You definitely want to let them sit for at least an hour and stir then at least every ten minutes because this is what creates the yummy juice that makes a great sauce when poured over cake. The cake soaked it up so it had the flavor of the strawberries too. I am going to make this again and again, while it's still strawberry season!

We served it over some pound cake with whipped cream and it was really tasty. The only thing that nagged at me that's making me go with 4 stars instead of 5 was that I wasn't sure it was substantially better than more traditionally just tossing strawberries with some sugar.

Oh MY!!! I made these along with the margarita cake listed on this site. A.M.A.Z.I.N.G! This was for my friends birthday and her husband called me later to let me know this is what he wants for his birthday! Just the perfect amount of tequila. They would be great on pre-made short cakes too. This is going into my favorties.
This was really tequila-heavy in flavour . too boozy for my tastebuds, felt more like a college party dessert..
Excellent! Fresh and great combo of flavors. Served with whipped cream.

This was fabulous! The flavors blend together perfectly. We had it on it's own and also served strawberry shortcake style with whipping cream and shortcakes. Make sure you pour the juice over top. Pure perfection! Yum!
These were fantastic. I used grenadine instead of triple-sec. These were a huge hit! Everyone loved them.
I added a little orange juice too! Delish
Do you like strawberry margaritas? Well, that's what these berries taste like. This simple recipe is awesome!!

This is easy, delicious, and addicting. I made the whole batch, but since it was just my husband and me, I only used half on the strawberries and refrigerated half in a jar for later! Cannot say enough about the complementing flavors! I served it over pound cake on Mother's Day but it is just as good solo.
